codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Source-checked answers about WARDOGS Early Access and the scope of this field guide.

items.question: What is WARDOGS?
items.answer: WARDOGS is a tactical first-person shooter on Steam with up to 100 players across three teams, a moving Control Zone, persistent cash, vehicles and building.

items.question: Does WARDOGS have fixed classes?
items.answer: No. The developer FAQ says equipment and vehicles define your role. This guide does not claim an independently tested best loadout.

items.question: How do you win a match?
items.answer: Have the most players inside the Control Zone at each 30-second scoring check. The first team to 100 points wins.

items.question: Is WARDOGS free to play?
items.answer: No. WARDOGS is a paid Steam Early Access game. Check Steam for current regional pricing and editions.

items.question: Are beta-era weapon values current?
items.answer: Not verified. The weapon catalogue labels community test-build data separately from confirmed Early Access information.
